summary: Benchmark Electronics filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 reporting that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.17 per share, payable October 13, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. The Tempe, Arizona-based printed circuit board and EMS provider disclosed no merger, tender, activist, or strategic-review activity. The filing is an ordinary capital-return declaration, not a special situation; no premium, stake, advisor, break fee, or regulatory clock appears. Watch only for future dividend policy changes or cash-flow coverage signals.
